profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Rivian
profile.summary:
As a developer, I strive to build functional web applications that enhance daily lives and user experience. I enjoy solving problems and discovering dynamic solutions with fellow developers while pair programming and incorporating agile methodologies. In addition, my background in customer-facing roles and finance has fostered my emotional intelligence and ability to explore and implement data-driven features.   

Skills:
Languages - JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
Platforms & Frameworks - Express.js, Node.js, AngularJS
Libraries - React, Redux, Apollo, JQuery, Bootstrap, Handlebars, Highcharts, Polyglot.js
Database Tools - PostgreSQL, ActiveRecord, MongoDB, Mongoose.js
Workflow - Github/Git, Bitbucket, JIRA, Heroku, Trello, Zube
Other - APIs, AJAX, JSON, BCrypt, Passport

GitHub profile: github.com/FranchiniMae
Portfolio: www.franchinimae.com
